limits: CVT bounds/final/reverse ratios, width/aspect tire sizing, RPM calibration, off-peak torque, load/inertia, handling, steering, aero, brakes, suspension rates and performance targets are simulation estimates, not factory calibration. Wheel diameter is factory equipment.
Native continuous CVT uses one forward ratio and existing approximate controller. No eight-speed gearbox, simulated manual steps, EyeSight, OEM active torque vectoring or SI-DRIVE modes claimed.
RTG-001 graphics/cockpit are shared placeholders, not this vehicle body, wheel appearance or cabin. Original art and vehicle-specific cockpit fitting remain Phase3.
Source mass excludes optional equipment; meaningful Base/RS engine/mass/suspension distinctions justify two variants.
